evidence.detail: The exact hover-region helper rs/l/q$a creates this record from the hovered text substring when the mouse enters its rectangle, caches it as the region's presentation payload and exposes it directly to the centralized overlay renderer.

rs/s/s/b is the live tooltip settings/producer path: it owns exact settings for tooltip overlay colors and entity/item tooltip visibility, keeps a singleton rs/l/f/a/j/a record and submits that record to rs/l/f/a/j/b for rendering.

The record stores the tooltip text plus optional booleans, item-id array, supplemental string array and presentation selectors consumed only by the tooltip renderer for plain text, icon/item and richer stat-line layouts.

candidates.note: TooltipContent is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the payload object passed from hover regions and tooltip producers into the centralized tooltip renderer. It does not claim the original developer identifier. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: Independent consumers feed this singleton with hover text/content from interface controls, generic hover rectangles, entity/item hover handling and UI sidebar entries; examples include 'Maximize', 'Minimize', 'Hide/show task', 'Task info' and 'Skip target'.

The renderer anchors from the live mouse coordinates Client.hP / Client.hQ, measures multiline text, clamps the box to the client viewport, draws the tooltip background/border/text and supports optional item/icon/stat layouts from TooltipContent.

The same overlay subsystem exposes a surviving TOOLTIP position enum in rs/l/f/l, while rs/s/s/a contains exact settings text naming 'tooltip overlays' and hover tooltips; rs/s/s/b routes those tooltip settings and records into this renderer.

rs/l/f/e constructs one rs/l/f/a/j/b singleton, registers it globally during overlay-system initialization and exposes it through f(), making it the shared tooltip overlay rather than a domain-specific widget renderer.

candidates.note: TooltipOverlay is fixed by exact hover consumers, mouse-relative box rendering, surviving tooltip configuration/position nouns and singleton registration in the overlay manager. Confidence is 0.999.
